title: Roadmap dependency registry and rolling-window alignment for cross-team plans
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Roadmap owners across Product, Engineering, Design, Security and Infrastructure lack a single, living source of truth for inter-team dependencies tied to cycles and OKRs. This results in last-minute blockers, missed rollout windows (especially for Dedicated/Private customers), and insufficient time for security reviews when features cross infra or compliance boundaries.

Goal: Implement a lightweight, queryable 'Dependency Registry' and a 6-week rolling-window cadence that surfaces upcoming blockers, ownership, and mitigations for every roadmap item. The registry should be easy to update from Linear and linkable from PRDs/Design specs so PMs can track cross-team gating items without having to chase owners in Slack.

Outcome metrics: 1) Reduce last-minute cross-team blockers delaying GA by 40% in 2 quarters. 2) Decrease average time between dependency identification and mitigation plan from 12 days to 4 days. 3) Increase proportion of roadmap items with at least one named cross-team contact from 65% to 95%.
acceptance_criteria: Dependency Registry UI (in Console) or lightweight Confluence table is writable from PMs and ENG leads and shows: dependent item, blocker type, owner, due date, mitigation, status, and linked artifacts (PRD/PR/Design).
Rolling-window view shows next 6 weeks by default with filters for team, OKR, release and priority.
Automated reminders created for stakeholders when a dependency status is 'Open' and due date is within 7 days.
Integrations: ability to link a Linear issue by key; registry entry created/updated when a PM toggles 'Has external dependency' on Linear ticket (alpha).
Cross-team verification flow: Security and Infra can add security_review_required flags that surface in the registry and trigger a one-click request for review (email/Slack notification).
tasks: PM: Draft schema for registry fields and examples (this ticket).
Eng: Prototype minimal API to read/write registry entries from Linear webhooks (ENG-2207).
Design: Wireframes for rolling-window view and registry CRUD flows (DES-452).
Security: Define required fields and gating states for compliance-triggered reviews (SEC-301).
Infra: Confirm events and telemetry for reminder scheduling and ownership routing (INFRA-129).
PM: Create Confluence template and Link in Console roadmaps; run pilot with 3 squads for cycle 2026-W11.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Too heavy a process -> teams opt out. Mitigation: Keep first version minimal, two mandatory fields (owner, due_date) and lightweight reminders.
Risk: Unclear ownership when dependency spans multiple subteams. Mitigation: Allow multiple owners and a single 'primary' contact; include escalation path in entry.
Risk: Security review delays. Mitigation: Add 'security_review_required' flag that auto-creates a review request and bubbles to Sec ops weekly triage.
timeline: Week 0 (2026-02-10): Finalize schema and coordinate initial stakeholders.
Week 2 (2026-02-24): Eng prototype + Design wireframes ready; first feedback loop.
Week 4 (2026-03-09): Alpha registry deployed to Confluence + integration demo; pilot begins with three squads.
Week 7 (2026-03-30): Pilot retrospective; iterate on UX and reminder cadence.
Week 10 (2026-04-20): Target GA for registry feature and rolling-window view in Console (stretch goal).
